elements.id-string-506: For $c>0$, the solution $u(n;t)=J_{2|n|}^{2c}(t)$, $n\in\mathbb{Z}$, $t\in\mathbb{N}_0$ to the discrete wave equation \eqref{discwaveq1} subject to the initial conditions \eqref{dweqcon1} has the following asymptotic behavior
